optedOut.0_log.ts: the timing surface. It measures stages the other modules own, and each of those is tagged at its own stage
optedOut.10_render.ts: the DOM pass. It renders what the view signals already decided, and each of those is tagged at its own stage
optedOut.12_transpose.ts: the seat table both axes cross through; cell.span and view.list are tagged where the view exposes them
optedOut.17_in_view.ts: the subscription runner. It decides when a demo's pipeline is open and claims no grid behaviour of its own
optedOut.6_gestures.ts: a pointer lifetime, shared by resize, move and range drag; every feature that uses it is tagged where it is implemented
optedOut.9_css.ts: writes the custom properties the theme reads; the features that decide those numbers are tagged in 8_grid.ts and 4_slice.ts
